name: 牧畜

pages.text: $(thing)家畜$() は、プレイヤーが飼いならして繁殖させることができる動物です。 家畜は $(thing)オス$() または $(thing)メス$() のいずれかになります。 一部の動物では、性別を視覚的に判断することができます。 たとえば、雄の豚には牙があります。
家畜は $(thing)老化$() を経験します。 彼らは赤ちゃんとして生まれますが、赤ちゃんは体が小さく、プレイヤーに資源を与えることができません。 一定の日数が経過すると、繁殖したり乳を生産したりできる $(thing) 大人$() の動物に成長します。 動物は繁殖したり、十分な回数使用されると $(thing)老いた動物$() になり、肉としてのみ役に立ちます。
この雄牛は高齢で繁殖ができません。色褪せた毛並みと灰色の見えない目をしています。
家畜に餌を与えて $(thing) 親密度 $() を高めることができます。 それぞれの動物には好んで食べる食べ物があります。 動物に餌をやるには、手に餌を持って $(item)$(k:key.sneak)$() と $(item)$(k:key.use)$() をします。
家畜には、どれだけあなたに慣れているかを示す $(thing)親密度$() があります。 $(item)$(k:key.sneak)$() を押しながら動物を見ると、動物の頭の上にそれが現れます。
餌を与えないと親密度は毎日少しずつ衰えていきます。 親密度を十分に高めると、白い輪郭のハートで示された分以上の低下が防止されます。
大人の家畜は完全に慣れることができないことが示されており、赤い枠線のハートで示されています。 赤ちゃんは100％の親密度に達することができます。
$(thing)哺乳類$()は$(thing)妊娠$()を経験する家畜です。30%以上の親密度があり、その日に餌を与えられた成体の哺乳類は、異性で近くにいる場合、交尾します。雌の動物は$(thing)妊娠$()し、受精後の一定の日数が経過すると子供を産みます。$(br)例えば、$(l:food/animal_husbandry#pig)ブタ$()がそうです。

$(thing)羊毛を持つ動物$()は、十分に親密であり、大人であれば$(thing)毛を刈る$()ことができる$(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)哺乳類$()です。例えば、$(l:food/animal_husbandry#sheep)羊$()、$(l:food/animal_husbandry#alpaca)アルパカ$()、および$(l:food/animal_husbandry#musk_ox)ジャコウウシ$()がいます。

Shears can be made by $(l:metalworking/anvils#welding)welding$() two $(thing)knife blades$() together. Whichever knife blade has the lowest forging bonus will transfer that bonus (if any) to the shears.
$(thing)乳用動物$()は、$(thing)ミルク$()を作る哺乳類です。雌の乳用動物は、バケツを使ってミルクを入手できます。例えば、$(l:food/animal_husbandry#goat)ヤギ$()、$(l:food/animal_husbandry#cow)牛$()、および$(l:food/animal_husbandry#yak)ヤク$()がいます。

pages.title: 巣箱
pages.text: $(thing)卵生動物$()は$(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)哺乳類$()ではなく、$(thing)卵$()を産んで子供を得ます。卵を産むには$(thing)巣箱$()が必要で、自力でそれを見つけることができます。$(br)例としては、$(l:food/animal_husbandry#duck)アヒル$()、$(l:food/animal_husbandry#quail)ウズラ$()、および$(l:food/animal_husbandry#chicken)ニワトリ$()がいます。
$(thing)卵$()は料理やゆでることで食べられます。雄の卵生動物は雌を受精させることができ、その結果、巣箱に産みつけられた次の卵が受精卵となります。受精卵には、孵化までの時間がツールチップで表示されます。

$(thing)Equines$() are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)Mammals$() that can be ridden when tamed. They become rideable after reaching 15% familiarity. Horses pass on their $(thing)genetic traits$(), including their speed, jump height, health, size, and markings. The product of a horse and a donkey is a $(thing)mule$().
Saddles may be knapped from leather.

乗るためには$(thing)鞍$()が必要で、革の$(thing)加工$()で作れます。これには$(l:food/animal_husbandry#mule)ラバ$()、$(l:food/animal_husbandry#donkey)ロバ$()、および$(l:food/animal_husbandry#horses)ウマ$()が含まれます。ラバとロバはチェストや樽を運ぶことができます。樽を持っている場合、$(item)$(k:key.sneak)$()を押しながら$(item)$(k:key.use)$()を押すと取り外すことができます。同じキーを使ってバケツを持っている場合、樽から液体を排出することができます。$(br2)次の数ページでは、すべての家畜の種類について説明します。

$(thing)Pigs$() spawn in mild forests with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between $(cfg:temperature:-10) and $(cfg:temperature:35), and at least 200mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)Mammals$() with no special abilities. They will eat any food, even if it is rotten. They have 1-10 children, are pregnant for just 19 days, and reach adulthood in 80 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: ブタ

pages.text: ブタ。

$(thing)Rabbits$() spawn in $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperatures$() above $(cfg:temperature:-16), and at least 15mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(), changing their coat based on climate. They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)Mammals$() with no special abilities, aside from being known for chewing on carrots and cabbage. They will eat any food, even if it is rotten. They have 1-6 children, are pregnant for just 19 days, and reach adulthood in 20 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: Rabbits

pages.text: A rabbit.

$(thing)Cows$() spawn in most climates, between $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() $(cfg:temperature:-10) and $(cfg:temperature:35), and at least 250mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#dairy_animals)Dairy Animals$(). They only eat $(thing)grains$(), which may be rotten. They can have 1-2 children, are pregnant for 58 days, and reach adulthood in 192 days. They can have children 13 times, if they are never milked, or be milked 128 times, if they are never bred. They produce milk every day.
pages.title: ウシ

pages.text: ウシ。

$(thing)Goats$() spawn in moderate climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between $(cfg:temperature:-12) and $(cfg:temperature:25), and at least 300mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#dairy_animals)Dairy Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(), $(thing)fruits$(), and $(thing)vegetables$(), which may be rotten. They can have 1-2 children, are pregnant for 32 days, and reach adulthood in 96 days. They can have children 6 times if they are never milked, or be milked 60 times if they are never bred. They produce milk every 3 days.
pages.title: ヤギ

pages.text: ヤギ。

$(thing)Yaks$() spawn in cold climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at most $(cfg:temperature:-11), and at least 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#dairy_animals)Dairy Animals$(). They eat only fresh $(thing)grains$(). They always have 1 child, are pregnant for 64 days, and reach adulthood in 180 days. They can have children 23 times, if they are never milked, or be milked 230 times, if they are never bred. They produce milk once a day.
pages.title: ヤク

pages.text: ヤク。

$(thing)Alpacas$() spawn in moderate climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between $(cfg:temperature:-8) and $(cfg:temperature:20), and at least 250mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#wooly_animals)Wooly Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1-2 children, are pregnant for 36 days, and reach adulthood in 98 days. They can have children 13 times, if they are never sheared, or be sheared 128 times, if they are never bred. They grow wool every 4 days.
pages.title: アルパカ

pages.text: アルパカ。

$(thing)Sheep$() spawn in drier climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between $(cfg:temperature:0) and $(cfg:temperature:35), and between 70 and 300mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#wooly_animals)Wooly Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(). They have 1-2 children, are pregnant for 32 days, and reach adulthood in 56 days. They can have children 6 times, if they are never sheared, or be sheared 60 times, if they are never bred. They grow wool every 3 days.
pages.title: ヒツジ

pages.text: ヒツジ。

$(thing)Musk Oxen$() spawn in cold climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between $(cfg:temperature:-25) and $(cfg:temperature:0), and at least 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#wooly_animals)Wooly Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(). They always have 1 child, are pregnant for 64 days, and reach adulthood in 168 days. They can have children 16 times, if they are never sheared, or be sheared 160 times if they are never bred. They grow wool every 3 days.
pages.title: ジャコウウシ

pages.text: ジャコウウシ。

$(thing)Bactrian Camels$() spawn in cold deserts, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at most $(cfg:temperature:-5), and at most 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#wooly_animals)Wooly Animals$() and can be ridden. They are slower than horses, but faster on sand and snow. They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1 child, are pregnant for 24 days, and become adults in 80 days. They can have children 8 times if they are never sheared, or be sheared 80 times if they are never bred. They grow wool every 7 days.
pages.title: Bactrian Camel

pages.text: A bactrian camel.

$(thing)Chickens$() spawn in warm forests, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least $(cfg:temperature:14), and at least 225mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#oviparous_animals)Oviparous Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(), $(thing)fruits$(), $(thing)vegetables$(), and $(thing)seeds$(), which can be rotten. Their eggs hatch in 8 days, and become adults in 24 days. They can lay eggs 100 times. They produce eggs every 30 hours.
pages.title: ニワトリ

pages.text: ニワトリ。

$(thing)Ducks$() spawn in most plains, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between $(cfg:temperature:-25) and $(cfg:temperature:30), and at least 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#oviparous_animals)Oviparous Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(), $(thing)fruits$(), $(thing)vegetables$(), $(thing)bread$(), and $(thing)seeds$(). Their eggs hatch in 8 days, and become adults in 32 days. They can lay eggs 72 times. They produce eggs every 32 hours.
pages.title: アヒル

pages.text: アヒル。

$(thing)Quails$() spawn in colder climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between $(cfg:temperature:-15) and $(cfg:temperature:15), and at least 200mm of  $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#oviparous_animals)Oviparous Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(), $(thing)fruits$(), $(thing)vegetables$(), and $(thing)seeds$(), which can be rotten. Their eggs hatch in 8 days, and become adults in 22 days. They can lay eggs 48 times. They produce eggs every 28 hours.
pages.title: ウズラ

pages.text: ウズラ。

$(thing)Donkeys$() spawn in wetter plains, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least $(cfg:temperature:-15), and between 130 and 400mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are a kind of $(l:food/animal_husbandry#horses)Equine$() that can carry a $(thing)chest$(). They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1 child, are pregnant for 19 days, and reach adulthood in 80 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: ロバ

pages.text: ロバ。

$(thing)Mules$() spawn in plains with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least $(cfg:temperature:-15), and between 130 and 400mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are a kind of $(l:food/animal_husbandry#horses)Equine$() that can carry a $(thing)chest$() and are the sterile product of a $(thing)horse$() and a $()donkey$(). They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They reach adulthood in 80 days.
pages.title: ラバ

pages.text: ラバ。

$(thing)Horses$() spawn in plains with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least $(cfg:temperature:-15), and between 130 and 400mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are a kind of $(l:food/animal_husbandry#horses)Equine$(). They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1 child, are pregnant for 19 days, and reach adulthood in 80 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: ウマ

pages.text: ウマ。

$(thing)Dromedary Camels$() spawn in drier climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least $(cfg:temperature:-5), and at most 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)Mammals$() that can be ridden. They are slower than horses, but are immune to cacti and run fast on sand. They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1 child, are pregnant for 19 days, and reach adulthood in 80 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: Dromedary Camels

pages.text: A dromedary camel.

$(thing)Frogs$() spawn in $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperatures$() above $(cfg:temperature:-13), and at least 150mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They can be familiarized, and when bred they will lay eggs in fresh water, which hatch into tadpoles. They will eat fish and spider eyes.
